Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Bergen Tufted Dining Room Kitchen Chairs, 38.6"H, Set of 2, Hemp Beige, Wood Oak
Colors: Hemp
Materials: stone
These lovely chairs combine Mid-century tufted backs with traditional elegantly curved legs. Performance fabric makes them easy to clean and durable for a busy family's wear and tear, and solid catalpa legs are sturdy and stable. 25.2"W x 21.3"D x 38.6"H 95% polyester/5% nylon on hardwood frame; solid catalpa wood legs; firm resilient padding Foam padding and elastic suspension system helps keep seat firm and resilient No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
